title: Sharḥ Ḥadīthayn
transliterated_title: Sharḥ Ḥadīthayn (variants Sharḥ-i Dō Ḥadīs-i Nabavī; Javāb-i Chand Suʾāl dar Harāt)

date.basis: The entry gives no date and lists no MS Majlis 10196 copy; earliest listed copy is 903-4/1497-98.

place: not stated (a variant title mentions Herat)
occasion: written in reply to an unknown correspondent
manuscript: MS 10004/17 pp. 270-72 (Majlis, Yazd 903-4/1497-98); MS 3035/7 ff. 45b-46b; MS Sipahsālār 2930. None in MS Majlis 10196.
summary: A brief philosophical, mystical and lettrist commentary on two hadiths (on the heart of the Quran being Yā-Sīn, and on the Quran's descent on seven ḥurūf), written for an unidentified correspondent.
